policy: Primary government/regulator publications establish law. An operator's own website establishes its published product terms, not legal permission or a personalized quote. Search snippets are discovery aids, not verification. English translations are reference translations; Chinese originals control. Blank means unverified, never zero.

sources.title: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则 (amended consolidated text)
sources.establishes: USD 50,000 annual facilitation quota for individual settlement and domestic-individual purchases; documented foreign-individual RMB income; 24-month original exchange memo reversal; USD 500/1,000 daily small reconversion; distinct account/cash remittance rules; the former RMB 1,000 fallback penalty was deleted.
sources.caveat: Quota classification is not determined by US citizenship alone. Confirm the bank's domestic/foreign individual classification and any permanent-residence-card exception.

sources.title: Individual foreign exchange administration reform questions and answers
sources.locator: Questions on annual quota and genuine demand
sources.establishes: The facilitation quota does not abolish genuine, documented transactions above it; borrowing quotas and splitting to evade controls are prohibited.

sources.title: 个人外汇业务服务小贴士
sources.locator: Domestic section Q8–13; foreign section Q1–14; cash Q4–6; migration/inheritance; trade
sources.establishes: Foreign individuals generally use documented RMB source materials including tax evidence for purchases; foreign permanent-residence-card holders have a purchase facilitation exception. Existing foreign-currency account remittance for foreign individuals is ID-based. Cash export bands and genuine trade procedures are distinct.
sources.caveat: Published 2021-10-22. Recheck branch practice and subsequent amendments; do not turn a facilitation threshold into a legal maximum.

sources.title: Regulations of the PRC on Foreign Exchange Administration, State Council Decree 532
sources.establishes: Evasion: ordinarily up to 30%, serious cases 30%–100%; false-document purchases: similar bands; cash-export violation: warning and up to 20%; unauthorized/disguised/illegal FX trading: ordinarily up to 30%, serious cases 30%–100%, confiscation and possible criminal liability. Unauthorized FX business has separate penalties.
sources.caveat: English is a reference translation. These are violation-specific sanctions, not transfer fees or a universal 30%–300% fine.

sources.title: Regulating large-sum overseas cash withdrawals with bank cards, Huifa [2017] 29
sources.establishes: All domestic cards under one person's name including supplementary cards: CNY 100,000 equivalent overseas cash withdrawals per calendar year; CNY 10,000 equivalent per card per day; exceeding annual cap suspends overseas withdrawals for current and following year. Effective 2018-01-01.

sources.title: Huifa [2012] 59, amended consolidated notice
sources.establishes: SAFE approval for a foreign individual's purchase/remittance of proceeds from transferring mainland commercial housing was cancelled; banks review the relevant materials. Later repeal notes remove obsolete attachments, not this operative paragraph.

sources.title: 移民财产转移购付汇核准 — administrative service guide
sources.locator: Conditions; application materials; approval procedure; fees
sources.establishes: Qualifying migration status, lawful assets owned before that status, identity/settlement and former-hukou evidence, source/title and tax documents; provincial SAFE processing; no administrative许可 fee; 20-working-day statutory decision period after acceptance, with possible extension under cited rules.
sources.caveat: This is Hebei's implementation guide. Use the competent former-hukou branch's current checklist. It is not a general route for every US citizen.

sources.title: 继承财产转移购付汇核准 — administrative service guide
sources.establishes: Foreign-citizen inheritance route requires inheritance and decedent-title evidence, identity/settlement evidence and tax documents; no administrative许可 fee; apply through the competent SAFE branch.
sources.caveat: Local implementation guide; confirm the decedent's former-hukou branch requirements.

sources.title: 个人财产转移购付汇业务问答（七）
sources.establishes: Migration applications go to the former-hukou SAFE branch; inheritance to the decedent's former-hukou branch; multiple decedents may be combined at one relevant branch.

sources.title: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法, PBOC Announcement [2004] 16
sources.establishes: Migration and inheritance definitions; lawful undisputed ownership; staged migration transfers; direct remittance to the applicant's own overseas account, not domestic cash withdrawal.
sources.caveat: Historical text. Do not reuse its old CNY 500,000 approval-routing threshold; later delegated implementation guides govern. Confirm any staging requirement with the competent branch.

sources.title: 个人购汇
sources.establishes: Original exchange memo valid 24 months; qualifying foreign-card RMB withdrawal evidence valid six months; lawful current-account income with transaction/tax evidence; property-sale document checklist.
sources.caveat: Page says local branch rules control. It is not a fee quote.

sources.title: 中国银行服务价目表 — current index
sources.establishes: The current posted personal tariff is effective 2025-11-11 until superseded; a separate ATM change starts 2026-11-11.

sources.title: Personal customer services: personal finance, effective 2025-11-11
sources.establishes: Cross-border TT/draft commission 0.1%, minimum CNY 50, maximum CNY 260; TT cable CNY 150 outside HK/Macao/TW or CNY 80 to those regions; draft postage actual. Overseas charges actual. Conditional USD full-arrival service USD 15/25. International debit overseas ATM 0.5%, min USD 3/max USD 5. Ordinary debit CNY 12 + 1%, max CNY 112. Carrying permit CNY 10 waived through 2026-12-31. Branch exchange does not charge the separate listed exchange-item fee.
sources.caveat: Not an FX quote. Fee currency conversion uses BOC's transaction-time buying rate if collected in FX. Full-arrival service is routing-dependent, not a universal cap on correspondent fees. ATM terms change 2026-11-11.

sources.title: Personal service fee adjustment effective 2026-11-11
sources.establishes: From 2026-11-11, overseas UnionPay: CNY 12 + 1%, cap CNY 112; Mastercard/Visa: 2.5%, minimum USD-equivalent 3, maximum USD-equivalent 40. Foreign ATM surcharge may remain separate.
sources.caveat: Future-dated on the research date; do not apply early.

sources.title: Remittances: telegraphic transfer and demand draft
sources.establishes: Recipient name/address/account and SWIFT details for TT; draft delivery/deposit procedure; cash-versus-remittance exchange prices differ; current tariff prevails.
sources.caveat: Old product page; use current tariff for prices.

sources.title: Guide to CNY transfers
sources.locator: Sending from CNY; eligibility, limits, payment steps
sources.establishes: Non-mainland-Chinese individuals with current/prior China work and qualifying tax records; personal transfers only to own overseas account/Wise account; overall limit generally documented salary net of China tax; bank-app funding cap CNY 300,000 and Alipay CNY 50,000 per transfer; own-name funding required.
sources.caveat: Operator eligibility is narrower than law. The page's tax-year example is stale; obtain a current document review. No personalized fee or FX quote was obtained.

sources.title: Fees for sending money
sources.establishes: Fees depend on amount, payment method and route; Wise describes mid-market pricing and large-transfer discounts.
sources.caveat: The fetched page did not expose a CNY-to-USD transaction quote. Do not substitute another corridor's percentage or a comparison site's estimate.

sources.title: SkyRemit service agreement
sources.establishes: After-tax mainland income to own overseas account; compliance review; indicative rate until confirmation; actual billed service fee controls; no guaranteed completion time; recipient/correspondent delays possible.

sources.title: Max. 300K in One Go!
sources.establishes: Published CNY 300,000 per-transaction maximum; CNY 79 fee in this notice; only own overseas accounts; special consular/diplomatic evidence exception; up to ten bank funding transfers may be consolidated.
sources.caveat: Undated product notice; current terms permit fee changes. Treat CNY 79 as a published reference, not a guaranteed quote.

sources.title: Send money from China
sources.establishes: Outbound service through partner banks; named online partners CEB, SPDB, PSBC and BOC mobile; government ID; bank account may be required; destination/passport/bank risk restrictions; overseas cash-pickup instructions.
sources.caveat: The page describes cash pickup, not verified direct-to-US-bank delivery. No fee, FX quote or US-passport-specific limit was verified.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国个人所得税法 (2018 amendment)
sources.establishes: China tax residence is domicile/183-day based, not citizenship-based; comprehensive income 3%–45%; business 5%–35%; specified passive/property categories ordinarily 20%; property gain net of basis/reasonable expenses; foreign tax credit; departure tax clearance; savings-interest rules delegated.

sources.title: 财税〔2008〕132号 — savings-deposit interest
sources.establishes: PRC individual income tax on savings-deposit interest is temporarily exempt for interest accrued from 2008-10-09 onward.
sources.caveat: This does not exempt the same interest from US tax or extend to every investment product.

sources.title: 财政部 税务总局公告2026年第27号 — foreign-individual dividends
sources.establishes: Foreign individuals' dividends from foreign-invested enterprises are subject to 20% PRC IIT; payer withholding and filing duties; former 1994 exemption repealed.
sources.caveat: Check treaty residence/entitlement separately. The announcement does not specify transitional treatment of pre-effective-date retained earnings; do not invent a grandfathering rule.

sources.title: Foreign-individual FIE dividend exemption FAQ
sources.establishes: Historical exemption under the 1994 policy.
sources.caveat: Superseded for the new policy's effective scope from 2026-09-01 by announcement 2026 No. 27; retained as an audit example of stale official guidance.

sources.title: 国税发〔2006〕108号 — housing-transfer IIT
sources.establishes: Actual transaction price; documented basis, transaction taxes and reasonable expenses; assessed IIT 1%–3% of revenue when basis cannot be established, set locally; conditional five-year self-use plus sole-family-home exemption.
sources.caveat: 2006 national text. Current local application and other transaction taxes must be checked; see Shanghai 2026 guide.

sources.title: International individual tax matters FAQ
sources.locator: Worldwide income / foreign tax relief questions
sources.establishes: US citizens/residents generally report worldwide income; relief may be available.
sources.caveat: FAQs are not primary legal authority; use instructions/statute for detailed conclusions.

sources.title: Foreign Tax Credit
sources.establishes: Credit may reduce US tax on the same income; generally only qualifying income taxes; limitations apply; no credit for tax on excluded income; treaty-reduced foreign tax matters.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 2555 (2026)
sources.locator: What's New; Who Qualifies; tax-home test
sources.establishes: 2026 maximum foreign earned income exclusion USD 132,900; foreign tax home plus bona-fide-residence or physical-presence qualification; earned income only.
sources.caveat: Not an exclusion for interest, dividends, property gains or pension income; not a tax on moving savings.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 8938 (11/2021, continuous use)
sources.locator: Who Must File; Types of Reporting Thresholds; Penalties
sources.establishes: US-resident unmarried/separate thresholds >50,000 year-end or >75,000 anytime; joint >100,000/>150,000. Qualifying abroad unmarried/separate >200,000/>300,000; joint >400,000/>600,000. Attach to annual return; FBAR remains separate. Initial USD 10,000 failure penalty; continuing USD 10,000 per 30 days after 90-day notice period, additional maximum USD 50,000.
sources.caveat: Threshold tests are strict 'more than'; presence-abroad and joint-asset rules matter. Filing FBAR does not replace Form 8938.

sources.title: Report Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts
sources.locator: Who Must File; individual filing; linked due-date clarification
sources.establishes: US persons with financial interest/signature authority and aggregate foreign accounts >USD 10,000 at any time in a calendar year file through BSA E-Filing. Linked FinCEN clarification sets April 15 due date and automatic October 15 extension.
sources.caveat: Trigger is account value, not the size of a single transfer.

sources.title: 31 CFR 1010.821, current as of 2026-11-05
sources.establishes: Adjusted maxima for penalties assessed on/after 2025-01-17: non-willful FBAR USD 16,536; willful USD 165,353. Statutory willful alternative and exceptions require the statute; these are not automatic charges.
sources.caveat: eCFR is authoritative but unofficial; amendment history cites 90 FR 5630. No newer amendment to this section appears in the fetched current timeline. Do not label these as a newly announced 2026 adjustment.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 3520 (12/2025, continuous use)
sources.locator: Who Must File; When and Where; Penalties
sources.establishes: Foreign individual/estate gifts/bequests >USD 100,000 aggregate; lower indexed entity threshold; separate foreign-trust rules; generally due with return/extension but filed separately; covered-expatriate gifts may have separate section 2801 tax.

sources.title: Gifts from foreign person
sources.locator: Reporting requirements; 2025/2026 thresholds; due dates; covered expatriates
sources.establishes: Discovery: IRS page lists USD 20,573 for 2026 foreign corporation/partnership purported gifts; full page still to be fetched before numeric publication.
sources.caveat: Aggregate related-party gifts; identify each gift >USD 5,000 for individual/estate threshold. Entity gifts may be recharacterized.

sources.title: Internal Revenue Bulletin 2025-45 / Rev. Proc. 2025-32
sources.establishes: 2026 FEIE USD 132,900 and section 6039F threshold USD 20,573 appear in the official bulletin search extraction; FEIE also directly verified in current Form 2555 instructions.
sources.caveat: FEIE cross-checked in current Form 2555 instructions; entity gift threshold cross-checked on IRS gifts page.

sources.title: 26 USC 988 (2024 edition)
sources.establishes: Disposition of nonfunctional currency including bank deposits can produce separately computed currency gain/loss; ordinary treatment generally applies. Personal-transaction gain exclusion does not apply if the gain on the transaction exceeds USD 200; business/investment transactions are outside the personal definition.

sources.title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
sources.locator: Who Must File; families/groups; monetary instruments
sources.establishes: Report >USD 10,000 equivalent crossing US border, collectively for families/groups; FinCEN 105; certain named/restrictively endorsed checks excluded; declaration is not a tax.
sources.caveat: Do not split among family members to avoid the collective threshold.

sources.title: Customs Clearance Guide for International Passengers
sources.establishes: RMB 20,000 and foreign-currency USD 5,000-equivalent declaration/control references; retain endorsed entry declaration for re-export.
sources.caveat: A declaration threshold is not permission to export any amount. Apply SAFE permit rules and check the undated guide's current local implementation.

sources.title: China tax treaty documents
sources.establishes: Official treaty text and explanation are available.

sources.title: US–PRC Income Tax Convention and Protocols
sources.locator: Table of articles; Protocol saving clause; Articles 4, 6, 9–12, 14, 22
sources.establishes: Residence, source-country taxing rights, 10% treaty limits on qualifying dividends/interest/royalties, double-tax relief and US saving clause. Treaty benefit is not automatic for every US citizen.
sources.caveat: Apply residence, beneficial ownership, income category and saving-clause exceptions to the actual facts.

sources.title: 银发〔2026〕42号 — virtual-currency and related risks
sources.locator: Sections I, III, VI; final paragraph
sources.establishes: Mainland virtual-currency-related business is illegal financial activity; overseas providers may not unlawfully serve mainland entities; institutions/payment providers may not facilitate it; 2021 No. 237 repealed. Effective on publication, document dated 2026-02-06.
sources.caveat: Do not reduce the notice to a claim that mere passive ownership is universally criminal; the proposed CNY-to-crypto-to-USD business/exchange route is excluded.

sources.title: About H.10

sources.title: Wealth Management Connect — Southbound Scheme
sources.locator: Operational arrangements; account opening and investment process

sources.caveat: Do not apply US consumer fees or assume China account eligibility.

sources.publisher: Supreme Court of the United States
sources.title: Bittner v. United States, No. 21-1195 (Feb. 28, 2023)
sources.establishes: Non-willful FBAR penalty under 31 USC 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) accrues per report, not per account. Willful account-based provisions are distinct.
sources.caveat: Statutory USD 10,000 base amount is inflation-adjusted separately; reasonable-cause exception still applies.

sources.title: FBAR Due Date Clarification PD 02-02-2018
sources.locator: Annual due date and automatic extension
sources.establishes: April 15 annual FBAR due date, automatic extension to October 15 without specific request; weekend/holiday rule follows federal income-tax guidance.

sources.title: 个人出售购入超过2年的住房 (2026-04-20)
sources.locator: IIT paragraphs (1)–(3); required materials; relief materials
sources.establishes: Shanghai guide: >2-year housing sale VAT exemption; IIT exemption for >5-year self-use and sole family home; otherwise 20% of net gain; 1% assessed IIT if basis cannot be established; documents for relief.
sources.caveat: Local guide, not a national 1% rate. Family sole home is within same province/municipality; other local taxes and US tax still apply.

sources.title: 银发〔2020〕330号 — optimizing cross-border RMB policy
sources.establishes: Domestic banks may handle individuals’ current-account cross-border RMB settlements under KYC/KYB/due diligence, including lawful salary income. Effective 2021-02-04.
sources.caveat: Not a blanket capital-account outbound permission; receiving bank must accept RMB and offshore conversion is a separate transaction.

sources.title: 国际汇款 — official product introduction
sources.establishes: Partner-financial-institution international remittance for verified Alipay real-name users; nine currencies including USD; page describes domestic-individual USD 50,000 annual purchase quota checked at creation/submission/bank processing.
sources.caveat: Undated page; foreign-passport eligibility, current fees, limits and US-bank delivery not verified. Do not confuse with Wise funding via Alipay or promotional flash-remit claims.

sources.title: 跨境支付 — merchant solution
sources.establishes: Consumer RMB payments to overseas merchants are converted by partner bank and settled to merchant accounts; this is merchant acquiring, not verified personal savings remittance.
sources.caveat: No personal CNY-to-USD outbound savings product verified.

sources.title: PayPal C2 consumer fees (last updated 2021-07-30)
sources.locator: Currency conversion; withdrawals from personal balance
sources.establishes: CN-market schedule lists USD 35 withdrawal to a US bank account and currency-conversion markups for PayPal balance transactions.
sources.caveat: Does not establish that a mainland Chinese bank CNY balance can fund this route; stale schedule and eligibility mean no route total is calculated.

sources.title: Streamlined Filing Compliance Procedures
sources.establishes: Non-willful certification required; civil examination/criminal investigation can bar eligibility; valid TIN; no automatic audit or closing agreement; willful concerns point to Criminal Investigation Voluntary Disclosure Practice with advisers.
sources.caveat: Do not promise reduced/no penalties or eligibility without facts; do not rely on removed delinquent-FBAR assurances.

sources.caveat: Operating guide; local housing eligibility and tax facts still apply. Do not use failed-purchase refund for unrelated CNY.
